requirements.text: WHEN the user clicks the active project card, the system shall open the project browser (existing behavior, no regression).
WHEN the inactive chip list is displayed (expanded or always), the system shall preserve favorites-first ordering from the selector manager.
The expand/collapse animation shall complete within 200ms.
The expand/collapse shall not cause layout shift or reflow of adjacent content.
The collapse behavior shall not conflict with the existing HoverCard on the active card or on individual chips.
No changes to useProjectSelectorManager hook shall be required.
IF there is only one inactive project, the system shall not show a collapse indicator and shall display the single chip inline.
WHEN the user rapidly hovers in and out of the collapse area, the system shall not flicker or exhibit animation jank.
WHEN the chip list is collapsed, keyboard users shall be able to focus the indicator and expand it via Enter or Space, then tab through the revealed chips.
WHEN the pointer enters the active project card, the system shall reveal the inactive chips inline to the right of the active card in the header line, overlaying subsequent header elements.
WHILE the pointer remains within the active card or the revealed chip strip, the system shall keep the chips visible.
WHEN the pointer leaves both the active card and the chip strip, the system shall hide the chips after a short delay.
WHEN the inactive chips are revealed, each chip shall appear with a soft staggered entrance animation.
The selector rail shall always hide inactive project chips by default; they are revealed only by hovering the active project card.

scenarios.title: Active card click opens project browser without regression
scenarios.given: the selector rail is visible with a collapsed indicator
scenarios.when: the user clicks the active project card

scenarios.title: Favorites-first ordering preserved in expanded list
scenarios.given: the selector rail has favorited and non-favorited inactive projects
scenarios.then: favorite chips appear before non-favorite chips in the list

scenarios.title: Chips hide when pointer leaves the active card and chip area
scenarios.given: the inactive chips are revealed next to the active card
scenarios.when: the pointer leaves both the active card and the chip strip
scenarios.then: the chips hide after a short delay

scenarios.title: Hovering the active card reveals chips inline to the right with stagger
scenarios.given: the selector rail has more than 3 inactive projects on desktop
scenarios.when: the user hovers the active project card
scenarios.then: the inactive chips appear inline to the right of the active card with a soft staggered entrance, overlaying header content, and stay visible while the pointer remains in the area

obligations.title: ProjectSelectorRail conditionally renders CollapsedChipsIndicator instead of inline chips when inactive count exceeds threshold
CollapsedChipsIndicator expands on pointer hover using CSS transitions, managed by useCollapsedChips hover state
CollapsedChipsIndicator supports keyboard expand via Enter/Space and tab navigation to revealed chips
Expand/collapse uses CSS transform+opacity transitions under 200ms with no layout reflow
Collapse container hover zone does not interfere with chip HoverCard popups or active card HoverCard
useProjectSelectorManager is not modified; collapse logic is purely presentational in the rail composition
CollapsedChipsIndicator renders chips in the same order provided by the rail, preserving favorites-first
Existing ProjectSelectorChip tests must pass unchanged to confirm no regression in chip rendering or HoverCard behavior
CollapsedChipsIndicator has component tests covering collapsed state, expanded state, keyboard interaction, and threshold behavior
types.ts may be extended with collapse-related props if the indicator needs shared types; no breaking changes to existing types

testPlans.title: Existing chip tests regression — no changes to chip component
CollapsedChipsIndicator unit tests — collapse/expand, keyboard, threshold, ordering, animation, reflow
useProjectSelectorManager unchanged — existing selector tests must pass without modification
Hover-reveal behavior — chips hidden by default, reveal on active-card hover, hide on leave, select works
